verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.130
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 4.130

verses.pali: 13. Bhayavagga
verses.english: 13. Fears

verses.pali: Cakkavattiacchariyasutta
verses.english: Incredible Things About the Wheel-Turning Monarch

verses.pali: “Cattārome, bhikkhave, acchariyā abbhutā dhammā raññe cakkavattimhi.
verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these four incredible and amazing things about a wheel-turning monarch.

verses.pali: Katame cattāro?
verses.english: What four?

verses.pali: Sace, bhikkhave, khattiyaparisā rājānaṁ cakkavattiṁ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanenapi sā attamanā hoti.
verses.english: If an assembly of aristocrats goes to see a wheel-turning monarch, they’re uplifted by seeing him

verses.pali: Tatra ce rājā cakkavattī bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
verses.english: and uplifted by hearing him speak.

verses.pali: Atittāva, bhikkhave, khattiyaparisā hoti, atha rājā cakkavattī tuṇhī bhavati.
verses.english: And when he falls silent, they’ve never had enough.

verses.pali: Sace, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇaparisā rājānaṁ cakkavattiṁ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanenapi sā attamanā hoti.
verses.english: If an assembly of brahmins …

verses.pali: Tatra ce rājā cakkavattī bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
Atittāva, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇaparisā hoti, atha rājā cakkavattī tuṇhī bhavati.
Sace, bhikkhave, gahapatiparisā rājānaṁ cakkavattiṁ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanenapi sā attamanā hoti.
verses.english: householders …

verses.pali: Tatra ce rājā cakkavattī bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
Atittāva, bhikkhave, gahapatiparisā hoti, atha rājā cakkavattī tuṇhī bhavati.
Sace, bhikkhave, samaṇaparisā rājānaṁ cakkavattiṁ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanenapi sā attamanā hoti.
verses.english: or ascetics goes to see a wheel-turning monarch, they’re uplifted by seeing him

verses.pali: Tatra ce rājā cakkavattī bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
verses.english: and uplifted by hearing him speak.

verses.pali: Atittāva, bhikkhave, samaṇaparisā hoti, atha rājā cakkavattī tuṇhī bhavati.
verses.english: And when he falls silent, they’ve never had enough.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro acchariyā abbhutā dhammā raññe cakkavattimhi.
verses.english: These are the four incredible and amazing things about a wheel-turning monarch.

verses.pali: Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, cattāro acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ānande.
verses.english: In the same way, there are these four incredible and amazing things about Ānanda.

verses.pali: Katame cattāro?
verses.english: What four?

verses.pali: Sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhuparisā ānandaṁ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanenapi sā attamanā hoti.
verses.english: If an assembly of monks goes to see Ānanda, they’re uplifted by seeing him

verses.pali: Tatra ce ānando dhammaṁ bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
verses.english: and uplifted by hearing him speak.

verses.pali: Atittāva, bhikkhave, bhikkhuparisā hoti, atha ānando tuṇhī bhavati.
verses.english: And when he falls silent, they’ve never had enough.

verses.pali: Sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhuniparisā …pe… sace, bhikkhave, upāsakaparisā …pe… sace, bhikkhave, upāsikāparisā ānandaṁ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanenapi sā attamanā hoti.
verses.english: If an assembly of nuns … laymen … or laywomen goes to see Ānanda, they’re uplifted by seeing him

verses.pali: Tatra ce ānando dhammaṁ bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
verses.english: and uplifted by hearing him speak.

verses.pali: Atittāva, bhikkhave, upāsikāparisā hoti, atha ānando tuṇhī bhavati.
verses.english: And when he falls silent, they’ve never had enough.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ānande”ti.
verses.english: These are the four incredible and amazing things about Ānanda.”

verses.pali: Dasamaṁ.
Bhayavaggo tatiyo.
Tassuddānaṁ
Attānuvādaūmi ca,
dve ca nānā dve ca honti;
Mettā dve ca acchariyā,
aparā ca tathā duveti.
